title: Collocations for Exams & Grades: vizsgázik, átmegy, megbukik

sections.title: Talking about exam results and grading
sections.content: In Hungarian, students say *átmegy a vizsgán* (to pass an exam, lit. go across on the exam with superessive *-n*) and *megbukik a vizsgán* (to fail an exam). Grades are referred to as *érdemjegyek* from 1 to 5.

items.spanish: A szóbeli vizsga után kaptam meg a jó érdemjegyet.
items.english: After the oral exam, I received the good mark.

items.spanish: Mindenki sikeresen átment az írásbeli vizsgán.
items.english: Everyone successfully passed the written exam.

items.spanish: Jó bizonyítvánnyal fejezte be a tanévet.
items.english: He finished the school year with a good report card.
